title: A Football Match
一场足球比赛

sentences: Kenny likes water sports, such as swimming, surfing, diving and windsurfing.
肯尼喜欢水上运动，比如游泳、冲浪、潜水和帆板。
He is also a big fan of football.
他也是足球的狂热粉丝。
In his opinion, football is more fantastic.
在他看来，足球更精彩。
Today he and his mum were watching a football match in the Olympic Stadium.
今天他和妈妈在奥林匹克体育场观看一场足球比赛。
Football players wearing special trainers were running from one side to the other.
穿着特殊运动鞋的足球运动员从一边跑到另一边。
"Mum, I really want to be a football player so that I can kick the ball well, just like them," Kenny said to his mum.
「妈妈，我真的想成为一名足球运动员，这样我就能像他们一样踢好球，」肯尼对他妈妈说。
"It's nice that you have a dream, but how much do you know about this sport?" asked Mum.
「你有梦想真好，但你对这项运动了解多少？」妈妈问。
"In the UK, people call it football, but it's called soccer in America.
「在英国，人们称之为football，但在美国它被称为soccer。
American football is another sport like rugby," answered Kenny proudly.
美式足球是另一项像橄榄球一样的运动，」肯尼骄傲地回答。
"You are right, my boy.
「你说得对，我的孩子。
In fact, maybe it will take many years to be a famous player.
事实上，也许要成为著名球员需要很多年。
You need to practise every day with your coach to enter a competition," Mum explained to Kenny.
你需要每天和教练一起练习才能参加比赛，」妈妈向肯尼解释道。
"It seems not easy to be a football player," said Kenny worriedly.
「看来当足球运动员并不容易，」肯尼担忧地说。
Just then his favourite team scored one goal and their scores were much higher than those of the other team.
就在那时，他最喜欢的球队进了一球，他们的分数比另一支球队高得多。
They were about to win.
他们快要赢了。
"Yeah!" Kenny cried excitedly and jumped off the seat.
「耶！」肯尼兴奋地叫道，从座位上跳了起来。
"This group is excellent and the players are strong.
「这支队伍很优秀，球员们很强壮。
No matter which match they are in, they will be the winner."
无论他们参加哪场比赛，他们都将是获胜者。」
"Of course," answered Kenny confidently.
「当然，」肯尼自信地回答。
"Kenny, look.
「肯尼，看。
I can't believe it — the group is about to lose.
我简直不敢相信 — 这支球队快要输了。
If they are a little faster, they will be the winner."
如果他们再快一点，他们就会是获胜者。」
"That's not fair!" said Kenny sadly.
「这不公平！」肯尼伤心地说。
Mum told him gently, "Maybe they're just not lucky this time...
妈妈温柔地告诉他：「也许他们只是这次运气不好……
We should believe they will get back and be the winner in the next event."
我们应该相信他们会重整旗鼓，在下一场比赛中获胜。」
"Of course, they will," said Kenny.
「当然，他们会的，」肯尼说。

words: You need to practise every day
The main events start at 1 p.m.
